annotations.title: Save a plant and a check-in

description: Use this when the user says something like "save this plant to Leafsight and remind me to look at it again". Adds one plant to the user's Leafsight account (its name, optionally its species and a short note of what they were told to do) with one check-in a number of days from now. It does not assess the plant and changes nothing that is already saved. Call it only when the user asks. Requires the user's Leafsight sign-in.

check_in_days.description: Days from today until the check-in, 1 to 30.

name.description: What the user calls the plant, e.g. 'Kitchen monstera'.

note.description: Plain text: what the user was told to do for this plant. Saved as the plant's note.

species.description: The kind of plant, if known, e.g. 'Monstera deliciosa'.

time_zone.description: The user's IANA time zone if known, e.g. 'Europe/Lisbon'. Leave out when unsure.

name: follow_plant
